page.title: Mendoza
page.meta_description: Mendoza's high desert vineyards turned a Bordeaux blending grape into Argentina's signature red. Related pages: Malbec, New World wine.
page.content:
Argentine Andean region that made Malbec a New World grape story.

How Mendoza connects

  • Item: Malbec — Malbec became Mendoza's signature exported grape.
  • Topic: New World wine — Mendoza is Argentina's New World Malbec capital.

What is Mendoza?

Mendoza's high desert vineyards turned a Bordeaux blending grape into Argentina's signature red.
